chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Ibn Faḍḍāl, from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī al-ʿAṭṭār, from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from Manṣūr, from the one he mentioned, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I said: When morning and evening come upon me and I do not see an Imam whom I may follow, what should I do?
He said: Then love whom you used to love, and hate whom you used to hate, until Allah, Mighty and Majestic, manifests him.

key_terms.أَئْتَمُّ: I follow as an Imam; I take as a leader in guidance
key_terms.إِمَامًا: the divinely appointed Imam to be followed
key_terms.وَأَبْغِضْ: and maintain hatred or disavowal toward falsehood

ai.seo_question: What should a believer do when the Imam is not visible during the occultation?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the condition in which the Imam is not outwardly accessible. It instructs the believer to remain firm in loyalty and disavowal, preserving prior allegiance to truth and opposition to falsehood until Allah, Mighty and Majestic, manifests the Imam. Its significance lies in affirming continuity of commitment during the period of occultation.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Al Attar, from Ja’far Bin Muhammad, from Mansour, from the one who mentioned it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said,
‘I said, ‘Whenever in the morning and evening I do not see an Imam<sup>asws</sup> I can follow as an Imam<sup>asws</sup> with, what should I do?’
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So love the one whom you used to love and hate the one whom you used to hate until Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic Manifests him<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 28. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Faddal from al-Hassan ibn Ali al-‘Attar from Ja’far ibn Muhammad from Mansur from the person he mentioned the following from abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.)
“I askked him, “If I passthe day and night and do not find Imam to follow then what should I do?”
The Imam (a.s.) said, “love those whom you love and hate those whom you hate until Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most gracious, will grant him permission to reappear.”
